arxiv-1410-8732.description: Abstract The sensitivity to B s B_{s} meson mixing phenomena can be significantly improved by distinguishing the initial meson flavour. The flavour tagging techniques used in the ATLAS measurement of the angular amplitudes contributing to B s → J / ψ ​ ϕ B_{s}\rightarrow J/\psi\phi decays are presented using 4.

arxiv-2109-13840.title: Stable nickel production in Type Ia supernovae: A smoking gun for the progenitor mass?
arxiv-2109-13840.creator: S. Blondin, E. Bravo, F. X. Timmes, L. Dessart, D. J. Hillier
arxiv-2109-13840.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by S. Blondin, E. Bravo, F. X. Timmes, L. Dessart, D. J. Hillier. At present, there are strong indications that white dwarf (WD) stars with masses well below the Chandrasekhar limit ( M Ch ≈ 1.4 M_{\mathrm{Ch}}\approx 1.4 M ⊙ \mathrm{M}_{\odot} ) contribute a significant fraction of SN Ia progenitors. The relative fraction of stable iron-group elements synthesized in the explosion has been suggested as a possible discriminant between M Ch M_{\mathrm{Ch}} and sub- M Ch M_{\mathrm{Ch}} events.

arxiv-2210-12217.title: Entailer: Answering Questions with Faithful and Truthful Chains of Reasoning
arxiv-2210-12217.creator: Oyvind Tafjord, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Peter Clark
arxiv-2210-12217.description: Abstract Our goal is a question-answering (QA) system that can show how its answers are implied by its own internal beliefs via a systematic chain of reasoning . Such a capability would allow better understanding of why a model produced the answer it did.

arxiv-2304-11975.title: MRSN: Multi-Relation Support Network for Video Action Detection
arxiv-2304-11975.creator: Yin-Dong Zheng, Guo Chen, Minglei Yuan, Tong Lu
arxiv-2304-11975.description: Abstract Action detection is a challenging video understanding task, requiring modeling spatio-temporal and interaction relations. Current methods usually model actor-actor and actor-context relations separately, ignoring their complementarity and mutual support. To solve this problem, we propose a novel network called Multi-Relation Support Network (MRSN).

arxiv-2308-10738.title: Homology reveals significant anisotropy in the cosmic microwave background
arxiv-2308-10738.creator: Pratyush Pranav, Thomas Buchert
arxiv-2308-10738.description: Abstract We test the tenet of statistical isotropy of the standard cosmological model via a homology analysis of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) temperature maps in galactic coordinates. The map pixels were normalized by subtracting the mean and rescaling by standard deviation, both of which were computed from the relevant unmasked pixels.

arxiv-2409-18996.title: From Linguistic Giants to Sensory Maestros: A Survey on Cross-Modal Reasoning with Large Language Models
arxiv-2409-18996.creator: Shengsheng Qian, Zuyi Zhou, Dizhan Xue, Bing Wang, and Changsheng Xu
arxiv-2409-18996.description: Abstract Cross-modal reasoning (CMR), the intricate process of synthesizing and drawing inferences across divergent sensory modalities, is increasingly recognized as a crucial capability in the progression toward more sophisticated and anthropomorphic artificial intelligence systems. Large Language Models (LLMs) represent a class of AI algorithms specifically engineered to parse, produce, and engage with human language on an extensive scale.

arxiv-2503-17745.title: Mixed Fields Formulation for Electromagnetic Waves Confined in Dielectric Rings
arxiv-2503-17745.creator: Ergun Simsek, Alioune Niang, Raonaqul Islam, Logan Courtright, Gary Carter, Curtis R. Menyuk
arxiv-2503-17745.description: Abstract This paper presents a complete formulation for analyzing electromagnetic wave propagation in dielectric ring structures with cylindrical symmetry. We develop a full-vectorial formulation based on Maxwell’s equations in cylindrical coordinates, employing three distinct approaches: E-field, H-field, and mixed E-H formulations.

arxiv-2602-21131.title: Invariance Principle and Dynamics
arxiv-2602-21131.creator: François Ledrappier
arxiv-2602-21131.description: Abstract . This is a survey of some invariances that arise in dynamical systems theory in the presence of zero Lyapunov exponents. 1. Introduction An active aspect of the theory of dynamical systems is the study of asymptotic properties of successive iterations of a transformation. This is performed through the description of global (often statistical) properties and objects.

pmc-11464807.creator: Hyeong Min Kim, Kwangsic Joo, Minji Kim, Young Joo Park, Ji Won Han, Ki Woong Kim, Sejoon Lee, Se Joon Woo
pmc-11464807.description: To identify genetic influences on subfoveal choroidal thickness of older adults using a genome-wide association study (GWAS). We recruited 300 participants from the population-based Korean Longitudinal Study on Health and Aging (KLoSHA) and Korean Longitudinal Study on Cognitive Aging and Dementia (KLOSCAD) cohort studies and 500 participants from the Bundang age-related macular degeneration (AMD) cohort study dataset.

pmc-11713387.title: Interventions for people living with dementia: updates from 2024 Lancet Commission
pmc-11713387.creator: Andrew Sommerlad, Jonathan D Huntley, Kathy Y Liu, Sergi Costafreda Gonzalez, Geir Selbaek, Suvarna Alladi, David Ames, Sube Banerjee, Alistair Burns, Carol Brayne, Nick C Fox, Cleusa P Ferri, Laura N Gitlin, Robert J Howard, Helen C Kales, Mika Kivimaki, Eric B Larson, Noeline Nakasujja, Kenneth Ro
pmc-11713387.description: BackgroundThe progressive nature of dementia and the complex needs means that people living with dementia require tailored approaches to address their changing care needs over time. These include physical multimorbidity, psychological, behavioural, and cognitive symptoms and possible risks arising from these and helping family caregivers.

pmc-12704573.title: Common Practice of Percutaneous Drainage in Necrotising Pancreatitis—A Multicentre Retrospective Study (DRACULA)
pmc-12704573.creator: Marlies Vornhülz, Simon Sirtl, Yujun Xu, Sarah Klauss, Elisabeth Orgler‐Gasche, Mihailo Bezmarevic, Milan Jovanovic, Claudio Ricci, Michael Fernandez Y Viesca, Marianna Arvanitakis, Amer Hadi, August Pilegaard Prahm, Davide Di Mauro, Dietrich A Ruess, Carola Focke, Fabienne Bender, Jacob Hamm, Chris
pmc-12704573.description: Background and AimsAcute necrotising pancreatitis carries high mortality, especially if infected necrosis occurs. While percutaneous drainage may be required when internal drainage is not feasible, reliable guidelines for managing percutaneous drains are lacking. This study aimed to assess the common practice of percutaneous drainage therapy for infected pancreatic necrosis.

pmc-12987772.title: Prognostic significance of CUX1 genomic deletion in myelodysplastic neoplasms
pmc-12987772.creator: Mohamed M. Khamis, Aleksandar Babic, Aref Al-Kali, Omar Alkharabsheh
pmc-12987772.description: BackgroundMolecular profiling has transformed risk stratification in myelodysplastic neoplasms (MDS). However, the independent prognostic value of specific genomic alterations beyond comprehensive molecular scoring remains unclear. We investigated whether CUX1 copy-number loss (haploinsufficiency) adds prognostic value and its association with other mutations. Given its correlation with chromosome 7 abnormality, we examined its independent significance within the current MDS molecular framework.

pmc-13218307.title: Periodontal status and microbial profiles across the clinical spectrum of liver cirrhosis
pmc-13218307.creator: J. B. O. Batista, E. H. de Souza Oliveira, L. A. M. Penteado, V. X. Nascimento, S. Matsumura, J. M. M. Silva, D. F. Nóbrega, B. Retamal-Valdes, M. Feres, S. M. S. Ferreira
pmc-13218307.description: ObjectivesPeriodontitis is common in patients with cirrhosis, but this association remains underexplored. This cross-sectional study aimed to assess periodontal conditions and characterize periodontal biofilm composition in individuals with liver cirrhosis.MethodsAdults with liver cirrhosis were enrolled. Periodontal parameters were recorded, and supragingival and subgingival biofilm samples were collected. Forty bacterial species were quantified using checkerboard DNA–DNA hybridization.

pmc-13241486.title: Intelligent label-free droplet microfluidic sorting system for single-cell encapsulation and morphology-guided screening
pmc-13241486.creator: Kefan Guo, Qingqing Liu, Huiling Yuan, Yuanyuan Zhang, Zhixian Zhu, Shu Zhu, Lin Jiang, Qinhong Wang, Nan Xiang
pmc-13241486.description: The label-free extraction of cellular morphological data from within droplet microenvironments, and its subsequent translation into reliable, high-precision sorting, continues to pose a central challenge in the field of droplet microfluidics. Here, we develop an intelligent label-free droplet sorting (ILFDS) system by integrating droplet microfluidics, real-time image recognition, and dielectrophoresis (DEP) sorting.

pmc-13307241.title: Synergistic Pyroelectric‐Bolometric Coupling in Tellurene Nanowire for Energy‐Efficient Artificial Vision
pmc-13307241.creator: Thi Uyen Tran, Ngoc Thanh Duong, Ngoc Linh Nguyen, Nayeong Lee, Minh Chien Nguyen, Koyal Suman Samantaray, Yoonmyung Lee, Seong Chu Lim, Sungjoo Lee
pmc-13307241.description: Thermal–energy harvesting, which converts heat into electrical signals, offers a promising route toward sustainable energy utilization. However, achieving efficient and stable thermal–electrical conversion in low‐dimensional materials remains challenging. Although few‐layer Tellurene (Te) exhibits pyroelectricity owing to intrinsic broken symmetry, this effect is confined to the trilayer limit, ‐restricting its practical applications.

pmc-13571707.title: Non-covalent assembly of chicory inulin and casein for the stabilization of blueberry anthocyanins: structural characterization, interaction mechanism and antioxidant activity
pmc-13571707.creator: Chong Ning, Linghui Lou, Huiyu Li, Wei Bu, Jing Li, Chang Tan, Chongting Guo, Shan Wang, Tiejing Li, Youlin Xue, Yin He, Weixuan Li
pmc-13571707.description: This study investigated the protective effects of chicory inulin (CI) and casein (CN) on blueberry anthocyanins (ACNs) and examined interactions within the ternary system. Stability was evaluated under thermal, formulation, storage, pH, in vitro digestion, and acidified model-beverage conditions, together with multispectral characterization and molecular docking. Fluorescence measurements showed that quenching depended on ACNs concentration.

pmc-13585861.title: Chromosome painting in plants: history and future perspectives
pmc-13585861.creator: Jiming Jiang
pmc-13585861.description: Chromosome painting was developed in mammalian species nearly four decades ago and rapidly became a powerful tool for chromosome identification, comparative cytogenetics, and evolutionary genome analysis. Comparative chromosome painting among diverse mammals generated much of the foundational knowledge of chromosome structure, chromosomal rearrangements, and karyotype evolution before the advent of whole-genome sequencing.
